* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Starship: Black 4, A New Hope, U2
|strategy=By Dan Holmes, Red 31<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/black4.html</ref>

[[Black 4]]. Just another TIE that is no more useful than the others, right? Wrong! [[Black 4]] should be considered one of the best secret weapons that the Imperial Navy has.

Just imagine this. Both sides are playing space. You have [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] on [[Black 2]] alone at [[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]]. The Light Side plays [[Han Solo]] on the [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] and initiates a battle. Normally, [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] would get beaten up, but not today. Because he is on [[Black 2]], [[Black 4]]'s game text allows it to deploy with a pilot for free. So now [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] comes out of nowhere against the [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] for a change. The tide of the battle has turned and the universe is one step closer to eliminating the Rebel threat.
|rulings=* To use the react text, you must have a piloted TIE there. It's even possible that other TIE was itself just deployed as a react a moment earlier.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], Black 4 (GEMP ID 2_151, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab), records the three later react and pilot-cost rulings. Its revised text permits a react to a battle "where you have a TIE"; the original face instead says a battle "initiated against a TIE." The record supports the later ruling about a TIE arriving by an earlier react, not proof that the original wording had the same timing. The Goldenrod interaction refers to the separate [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/LightPreErrata.json#L1846-L1859 Goldenrod record in LightPreErrata.json] (GEMP ID 200_27), whose pre-22 July 2024 text charges 2 Force for deployment made free by another card. It is not a substitution of Yavin Sentry & Goldenrod for that historical card. Preserved Dark data copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026). Lookup: [https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Black%204 Scomp: Black 4].</ref>
* When using the react text to deploy for free, the pilot is also free.
* When using [[Black 4]]'s text to deploy it and a pilot for free, and Goldenrod on table, must use 2 Force for the pilot (but 0 for [[Black 4]]).
